Hello Filomena,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to inform you that charger outlet were temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error, the COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the SiC D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue.
The issue has been resolved, Outlets are available now.
I trust that  your query has been addressed, and you are satisfied with the provided answer.
The charger is now healthy, with no active error flags, and all outlets are available.
Could you kindly verify from your side and confirm that everything is functioning as expected?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita
